title: SKUTemplate
description: Schema for declarative SKU DAG batch job pipeline templates.

sku_id.description: Unique identifier slug for the SKU template.

display_name.description: Human-readable title describing the batch production pipeline.

pipeline.description: Ordered execution stages for the pipeline.

input_format.description: Expected intake artifact or dataset format.

input_columns.description: Expected input record keys, headers, or parameters.

output_format.description: Target artifact format produced by the final pipeline stage.

output_columns.description: Keys or files produced by the pipeline.

quality_rules.description: Strict qualitative and quantitative constraints evaluated during QA stages.

estimated_minutes_per_record.description: Estimated processing time per record in minutes.

estimated_minutes_per_course.description: Estimated processing time per course unit in minutes.

courses_per_batch.description: Standard batch unit count for academic courses.
